name: TD First Class Visa Signature® Credit Card

localized_names.en: TD First Class Visa Signature® Credit Card

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: Annual fee of $89 is waived the first year.

apr.notes: 16.74% variable APR on purchases. 0% introductory APR on balance transfers for the first 12 billing cycles for transfers made within the first 90 days of account opening; after that, 16.74% variable APR. Cash advance fee is $10 or 3% of advance, whichever is greater.

base_rate.description: Earn 1X First Class miles on all other purchases. Miles never expire as long as your account is open and in good standing.

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem your miles for travel, cash, entertainment and more. 25,000 bonus miles equals a $250 statement credit towards travel or dining purchases.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 25,000 bonus miles when you spend $3,000 within the first 6 billing cycles. 25,000 bonus miles equals a $250 statement credit towards travel or dining purchases. Bonus miles reflected on your credit card statement 6 to 8 weeks after a qualified first purchase.

benefits.title: Visa Zero Liability
benefits.description: Enjoy Visa security on purchases, plus protection against unauthorized charges.

benefits.title: Emergency Card Replacement
benefits.description: Every TD Bank Credit Card comes with an added layer of protection such as emergency card replacement.

benefits.title: Roadside Assistance
benefits.description: Every TD Bank Credit Card comes with roadside assistance and more.

notes: Verified from official product page. 3X First Class miles on travel and dining purchases (flights, hotels, car rentals, cruises and dining), 1X miles on all other purchases. Miles never expire. $89 annual fee waived the first year. No foreign transaction fee. 16.74% variable APR on purchases. Visa Signature tier.
